note_for_reviewer: Every emblem in this video was built with funkbox poster layers (shape, solid, gradient, text, and for the two mashups an svg layer holding funkbox's own SVG export of the shield poster): see emblem/*.poster.json and emblem/renders/. The PNGs in the state repo's refs/hebrew-emblem-v2/ (hand-made SVG) were used only as the reference that poster_compare scores against; they appear on screen only inside poster_compare's labelled sheet ('reference (fitted)'). Each poster's text_audit.json shows its strings exact. The emblem redraws an existing organisation's emblem; the two IDF-insignia mashups are covered by owner_approval.json, which approves that content only.
